Conflicts among the optimization objectives remain admissible for downstream reconciliation.","witnesses":["The anchor policy and hash are immutable and score information is withheld.","The contract requires interface legality, capacity safety, and online-only visibility.","The task constraints require standard-library-only implementation, one-access-at-a-time operation, unique currently cached integer eviction keys, capacity safety, and prohibition of benchmark or oracle adaptation.","The candidate hypothesis supplies an expected effect and falsifier but no observed score or validating evidence.","The loop explicitly requires this call to emit analysis only and the final call to honor binding exclusions while retaining common-input visibility."],"obligations":["Preserve the anchor, task, contract, constraints, hypothesis, and loop structure as visible evidence for the final call.","Treat unsupported performance claims, score interpretations, hidden-trace assumptions, oracle behavior, benchmark knowledge, and source-class gating as inadmissible commitments.","Keep unresolved tradeoffs among hit rate, byte hit rate, scan resistance, phase adaptation, and regret explicitly admissible rather than resolving them by unsupported preference.","Require any downstream artifact to retain the declared interface, use only permitted online information and standard-library facilities, remain capacity-safe, and return only unique currently cached integer keys.","Do not emit or imply a policy artifact from this call."],"exact_actions":["Carry the complete visible evidence forward unchanged.","Mark each unsupported commitment as a binding exclusion for the final call.","Preserve admissible conflicts and uncertainty without ranking or selecting among policies.","Permit construction only within the resulting admissible boundary."]},"artifact_kind":"analysis_only"}
